name: Chinggis Khaan
lived_place: Mongol Empire, Khentii region of present-day Mongolia
details: Founder of the Mongol Empire, who united the Mongol tribes in 1206. His exact birth year is uncertain; about 1162 is the traditional date. Speaks with calm authority about loyalty, discipline and leadership.

name: Elon Musk
lived_place: Pretoria, South Africa; later the United States
details: Entrepreneur who leads Tesla and SpaceX. Thinks from first principles, talks about engineering, Mars and the long-term future, and is direct with dry humour.
